summary:
Ongoing stress can show up as brain fog, forgetfulness and low mood. That is because chronic stress acts on the same brain systems that manage attention, memory and mood, so they tend to move together, and they tend to ease as the load comes down.

Our article explains what ongoing stress does to the brain and the small things that help the system settle.

Equal Psychology provides psychological care for adults and older adults in Kew, Croydon, and online across Melbourne. Medicare rebates available with a GP referral.

Read it on our blog: https://equalpsychology.com.au/blog/chronic-stress-and-the-brain
